scope: scripts/qualify_motion_connections.py on Debug builds of a1c00283 (artifacts/dt2, git archive) in an owned scratch CPU 1511-1 PN V4.1 with a TM PosInput 2 V2.0, an AQ 2xU/I ST and a SINAMICS G120C PN on the CPU's IO system. New: to_connect's Startdrive telegram target. A real TO_SpeedAxis 10.0 actor connected to the G120C drive object's MainTelegram (telegram 1, byte 256 in and out) through AxisEncoderHardwareConnectionSDRInterface.Connect(Telegram), then replaced through Connect(Telegram, ConnectOption.Default); each apply checkpointed, PLC-compiled and saved, read back IsConnected with InputAddress/OutputAddress 2048 (bits), and equal after a fresh Portal reopen. Typed refusals left the slot unchanged: an unknown telegramType and a channel index (InvalidRequest), SafetyTelegram (SafetyBoundary). V21 refused the virtual TO_PositioningAxis torque interface on telegram 1 (Target not available for input=2048 and output=2048); the failed apply was restored from its checkpoint. The earlier encoder, measuring-input and analog-actor cases reran unchanged.
limitations: One G120C PN (not commissioned in Startdrive) with only its main telegram 1, addressed by driveObjectIndex; supplementary and torque telegrams, other drives and S120 drive objects are not exercised.
Torque on a drive telegram stays unverified: V21 refused it on telegram 1, and Startdrive refuses a torque telegram on the G120C.
Engineering only; nothing is downloaded and no axis moves; the drive is never compiled.
